description: Source code for flash image handling in Zephyr OS, including functions for buffered writing, initialization, and image verification.

methods.name: flash_img_buffered_write
methods.description: Writes data to flash with optional flushing and handles progressive erase if enabled.

methods.name: flash_img_bytes_written
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes written to flash.

methods.name: flash_img_init_id
methods.description: Initializes flash image context with specified area ID.

methods.name: flash_img_init
methods.description: Initializes flash image context with default upload area ID.

methods.name: flash_img_check
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of the flash image using SHA256 checksum.
